title: Bid Manager
description:
Overview

WELCOME TO SITA

At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.

You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don't just move the world forward—we're proud to be recognized as a Great Place to Work by our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.

Are you ready to love your job?

The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.

ABOUT THE ROLE & TEAM

Manages new and renewal business opportunities related to managed, major and/or complex solutions. Plays an active part in the entire proposal project life cycle, challenge solutions and drive best practice for major or complex deals. Ensures that SITA is portrayed professionally and with credibility

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Validates the qualification of opportunities and monitors qualification status at all stages during the bid process.
  • Analyses and understands the customer's detailed requirements in order to develop the optimum win strategy and associated appropriate level of response in order to successfully bid and win each contract.
  • Develops the overall bid project plan and builds and manages the virtual Bid Team to achieve the bid deliverables in an effective and efficient manner. This includes leading the process of identifying potential subcontractors or partners and selecting / negotiating / contracting with such parties under the guidance of senior regional / commercial management.
  • Owns and reviews the overall response to customer, assessing the risk to delivering a successful bid project, and ensuring that these are addressed appropriately under the guidance of senior regional / commercial management.
  • Coordinates the negotiation team in the pre-contract stage with the Customer, including the setting up of appropriate commercial partnership agreements and underpinning contracts to support contract deliverables whilst ensuring that the relevant internal expertise is involved in the closure of commercial, financial and legal issues with the customer.
  • Develops plans to ensure a smooth transition from the bid team to the delivery and implementation team upon contract award, including comprehensive and clear documentation of all aspects of the solution.
  • Helps obtains solution approvals (financial, technical etc) and ensures the proposed solution is carried out in accordance with the appropriate corporate guidelines.
  • Communicates progress regularly and clearly to the relevant SITA senior management and stakeholders, ensuring that major issues are escalated and addressed.
Qualifications

WHO YOU ARE 

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional qualifications in Economics, Business Administration, Finance or Legal.
  • Verifiable 5 + years of experience in commercial or similar roles with strong project management skills across multiple teams in multiple locations is required
  • Must have Proposal Management, Sales, Business Development or Account Management experience.
  • Experience in aviation industry or IT is a plus.
  • Hands-on experience and verifiable experience in complex bids & proposals - in purchasing and/or sales - including exposure to the vendor side.
  • Relevant understanding of the airport and/or airline operation is an advantage.
  • Experience in developing successful relationships at Senior Manager level.
  • Preferably having worked in a multinational company.  

WHAT WE OFFER

We're all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We're really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.

Flex Week: Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your team's needs)

Flex Day: Make your workday suit your life and plans.

Flex-Location: Take up to 30 days a year to work from any location in the world.

Employee Wellbeing: We have got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health - a personalized platform that supports a range of wellbeing needs.

Professional Development: Level up your skills with our training platforms, including LinkedIn Learning

Competitive Benefits: Competitive benefits that make sense with both your local market and employment status.

SITA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value a diverse workforce. In support of our Employment Equity Program, we encourage women, aboriginal people, members of visible minorities, and/or persons with disabilities to apply and self-identify in the application process.

title: Digital Catalog Strategy Sr Manager

Sony Music Entertainment Brazil is one of the country's leading entertainment groups and part of the global Sony Music Entertainment family. Our mission is to drive music and culture forward by connecting artists and fans through innovation, creativity, and operational excellence. We operate across all segments of the music industry, from developing new talent to celebrating an iconic catalog, always with the goal of inspiring and transforming through music.

We are looking for a Senior Manager, Digital Catalog Strategy, who is passionate about music and deeply connected to the digital landscape. This person will be responsible for leading strategic initiatives aimed at enhancing the performance, visibility, and relevance of the company's catalog across streaming platforms, social media, and other digital channels.

The primary focus of this role is to maximize engagement and consumption of the catalog, from timeless classics to major hits, connecting different generations of fans through content, storytelling, and digital innovation.

What you'll do:

  • Lead a diverse team, fostering integration with local (Sony and Som Livre) and international teams.
  • Be responsible for catalog repertoire KPIs and overall performance goals for Sony/Som Livre.
  • Test and model new strategies to grow catalog music audiences across major digital platforms (Spotify, YouTube, Amazon, Apple, Deezer, etc.).
  • Plan and manage the area's budget efficiently, investing in: content marketing, paid media, channel optimization strategies, creative projects and events, page and game creation,influencer partnerships and other innovative initiatives.
  • Ensure the effective execution and tracking of action plans, campaigns, projects, and events.
  • Analyze performance and conversion results, implementing data-driven improvements.
  • Collaborate closely with other Sony teams (Sales, Playlist Strategy, BI, Creative, Media, Marketing, and A&R) to analyze user behavior, generate insights, test hypotheses (A/B testing), and optimize revenue by reducing media dependency.
  • Stay up to date with market trends in music, digital marketing, and UX.

Who you are:

  • Loves music and is an active user of streaming platforms.
  • Is results-driven and focused on the company's key KPIs.
  • Has strong strategic thinking and structured reasoning.
  • Demonstrates excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Responds calmly under pressure and manages conflicts and risks effectively.
  • Communicates clearly with cross-functional stakeholders at multiple levels, building trust and credibility.
  • Can create compelling, storytelling-driven presentations.
  • Is proactive, self-motivated, and enjoys sharing knowledge and fostering team collaboration.
  • Manages time and resources efficiently, setting priorities and delegating effectively.
  • Is engaged in developing the team, offering fair and constructive feedback, and empowering people to make responsible and assertive decisions.
  • Is curious, creative, and constantly seeking innovative ways to act in the market.

  • Degree in Engineering, Economics, Data Science, Marketing, Advertising, or Business Administration.
  • Postgraduate degree or MBA in Marketing and/or Business Administration.
  • 10+ years of professional experience.
  • 3+ years of team management experience.
  • Strong background in Marketing, Digital, or Growth within music, tech, media, digital marketing agencies, or social media companies.
  • Advanced knowledge of Excel/Google Sheets and PowerPoint/Canva.
  • Experience with Google Ads (Search, Display, and YouTube), Facebook Ads, YouTube Analytics, and Facebook Insights.
  • Experience using AI tools such as Copilot, ChatGPT, or Gemini to increase work efficiency.
  • Knowledge of SEO strategies, UI/UX best practices, viral marketing, content marketing, and growth hacking.

title: Estágio na área de tecnologia
description:
Who are we?

Equinix is the world's digital infrastructure company, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet. 
 

A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.

A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You'll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You'll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you're empowered to do your best work.

A Equinix é a empresa global de infraestrutura digital, operando mais de 245 data centers em todo o mundo e fornecendo interconexões para todas as principais nuvens e redes. As empresas precisam de um lugar para simplificar e reunir uma infraestrutura fragmentada e complexa que abrange ambientes de nuvem privada e pública. Nossa plataforma global permite que os clientes coloquem a sua infraestrutura onde precisarem e conectem a tudo o que precisam para ter sucesso.

Somos uma empresa global de rápido crescimento, com mais de 20 anos consecutivos de crescimento. Por meio de nosso portfólio inovador de produtos e serviços de alto desempenho, criamos o maior e mais ativo ecossistema global de cerca de empresas, incluindo mais de 2.000 e mais de 3.100 provedores de serviços de TI e nuvem em mais de 32 países nos cinco continentes.

Uma carreira na Equinix significa que você colaborará em trabalhos que impactam o mundo e estará cercado por oportunidades infinitas de aprender novas habilidades e crescer em várias direções.

Abraçamos a diversidade de pensamento e contribuição e estamos comprometidos em fornecer um ambiente de trabalho igualitário. Isso é fundamental para nossos valores essenciais como empresa e é vital para nosso sucesso.

Em nosso estágio, você terá oportunidade de:

Trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico e rápido, contribuindo com projetos;

Trabalhar com pessoas de diferentes áreas de especialização e conhecimentos;

Contribuirá na análise de indicadores e relatórios de conformidade

Apoiará em iniciativas de conscientização e treinamento dos colaboradores

Apoiará em atividades de levantamento e análise de dados para indicadores de desempenho

Apoiará na correção e atualização de cadastros

O que você precisa ter:

Estar cursando Ensino Superior nos cursos de: Tecnologia da Informação, Sistema da Informação, Engenharia da Computação, Gestão de TI, Gestão de Projetos, Engenharia de Produção, Administração e/ou correlatos.

title: recepcionista para clinica medica
description:
A principal função de uma recepcionista de clínica médica é ser o primeiro ponto de contato entre os pacientes e a clínica, realizando atendimento, agendamentos e organização geral para garantir um bom fluxo de trabalho e a satisfação do paciente. As tarefas incluem atender chamadas, recepcionar presencialmente, agendar consultas e exames, confirmar agendamentos e lidar com questões administrativas, como contato com convênios para autorizações.

Funções administrativas e de organização

  • Agendamento:
     Marcar consultas, exames e procedimentos, além de confirmar os compromissos com os pacientes.
  • Atendimento:
     Atender pacientes e visitantes presencialmente, por telefone e por e-mail, respondendo a dúvidas e orientando-os.
  • Documentação:
     Organizar guias de consultas e exames, abrir fichas ambulatoriais e, quando necessário, contactar convênios para autorizações.
  • Gestão de fluxo:
     Controlar a entrada e saída de pacientes das salas de atendimento e auxiliar na organização dos espaços.

Funções de atendimento e relacionamento

  • Acolhimento:
     Recepcionar os pacientes de forma acolhedora, prestando um atendimento cordial e humanizado.
  • Comunicação:
     Transmitir informações com clareza, tanto para os pacientes quanto para a equipe médica e administrativa.
  • Resolução de problemas:
     Lidar com situações difíceis com tato, paciência e boa comunicação.
  • Feedback:
     Contribuir para o bem-estar do paciente enquanto ele aguarda o atendimento, sendo responsável pela primeira impressão que ele tem da clínica.

title: Hedge Accounting Specialist
description:
Job Purpose


We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Hedge Accounting Specialist to join our finance team. The successful candidate will be responsible for the end-to-end process of hedge accounting, including derivative instruments analysis, hedge effectiveness assessments, and accounting under ASC 815 (or IFRS 9, as applicable).

Job Description



•    Derivative Instruments Accounting & Analysis: Monitor, account for, and analyze all derivative transactions including forwards, swaps, options, and futures. Ensure proper classification and valuation in accordance with hedge accounting standards.
•    OCI (Other Comprehensive Income) Analysis: Prepare and review OCI entries related to hedge accounting. Analyze fluctuations and report impacts on financial statements.
•    Hedge Cost Allocation: Analyze and allocate hedge costs between business units or cost centers. Track cost of hedging strategies (e.g., forward points, option premiums) and ensure correct accounting treatment.
•    Spot and Forward Points Rate Analysis: Perform in-depth analysis on spot vs. forward points movements and their impact on hedging relationships and financial results.
•    Mark-to-Market (MTM) Analysis: Calculate and explain changes in the fair value of derivative positions. Work with valuation models and external pricing sources.
•    Hedge Effectiveness Testing & Documentation: Execute prospective and retrospective effectiveness tests (qualitative and/or quantitative). Maintain comprehensive documentation for audit and compliance purposes.
•    Collaboration & Reporting: Work closely with Treasury, FP&A, and external auditors to ensure the accuracy and transparency of hedge accounting results. Prepare reports and dashboards as needed for internal stakeholders.
•    Compliance & Controls: Ensure adherence to internal controls and compliance with accounting standards such as ASC 815 or IFRS 9. Support external and internal audits as required.
•    FX Analysis - Conduct detailed Foreign Exchange variance analysis to identify and explain deviations in currency conversion impacts across global transactions enabling data-driven insights.

You are meant for this job if:



•    Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Economics (MBA is a plus)
•    Experience in hedge accounting, financial reporting, or treasury operations
•    Strong understanding of derivative instruments and financial risk management
•    In-depth knowledge of hedge accounting under ASC 815 and/or IFRS 9
•    Proficient in Excel and financial systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Kyriba, or similar treasury systems)

At Mindrift, innovation meets opportunity. We believe in using the power of collective intelligence to ethically shape the future of AI.

What we do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real-world expertise from across the globe.

About the Role

Generative AI models are improving very quickly, and one of our goals is to make them capable of addressing specialized questions and achieving complex reasoning skills.

Although every project is unique, you might typically:

  • Content Creation & Refinement: Create and refine content to ensure accuracy and relevance across a variety of topics, while also developing references and examples of tasks.
  • Experts Acquisition: Assess the qualification tests of experts, ensuring their competency.
  • Chat Moderation: Provide support by addressing project-related questions from other experts in Discord chats, especially those related to project guidelines.
  • Auditing Work: Review and evaluate tasks completed by other experts, ensuring they align with project guidelines. Provide constructive feedback, verify expertise-related information, and edit content as necessary to improve quality.

How to get started

Simply apply to this post, qualify, and get the chance to contribute to projects aligned with your skills, on your own schedule. From creating training prompts to refining model responses, you'll help shape the future of AI while ensuring technology benefits everyone.

  • You hold a Master's or PhD degree in Mathematics.
  • You have at least 5 years of professional experience.
  • Your level of English is advanced (C1) or above.
  • Working knowledge of Python.
  • Experience in Generative AI/Prompt engineering/Reviewing
  • You are ready to learn new methods, able to switch between tasks and topics quickly and sometimes work with challenging, complex guidelines.
  • Our freelance role is fully remote so, you just need a laptop, internet connection, time available and enthusiasm to take on a challenge.

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Get paid for your expertise, with rates that can go up to $14/hour depending on your skills, experience, and project needs.
  • Take part in a part-time, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments.
  • Work on advanced AI projects and gain valuable experience that enhances your portfolio.
  • Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise.

O Grupo FQM é uma empresa da Indústria Farmacêutica que atua há 93 anos no Brasil (desde 1932), faz parte do Grupo Roemmers, multinacional com sede na Argentina, posicionado entre os cinco maiores grupos farmacêuticos da América Latina. No Brasil, a FQM ocupa a 12ª posição do ranking da Indústria Farmacêutica com faturamento acima de 2 bilhões de reais ao ano. Com um amplo portfólio de medicamentos, suplementos, cosméticos atua em 02 segmentos: Medicamentos de prescrição médica (RX) em diversas especialidades terapêuticas, e consumo (OTC) produtos para o autocuidado, isentos de prescrição médica, destinados diretamente ao consumidor final.
A FQM, com mais de 1500 colaboradores, vem escrevendo sua história através de constante aprimoramento do seu portfólio de produtos e processos e da busca incessante pela inovação e excelência para atender às necessidades do mercado farmacêutico no país, promovendo Saúde, Autoestima, Bem-estar e Qualidade de Vida à toda população. 
Descrição Sumária:
Desenvolver e validar metodologias analíticas para serem utilizadas pelo Controle de Qualidade para confirmar a qualidade das matérias-primas e dos produtos. Conduzir Estudos de Estabilidade a fim de determinar o prazo de validade dos produtos.
 
Local de trabalho: Jacaré/Rio de janeiro.
 
Principais atividades:
 
Elaborar os protocolos e executar testes experimentais de desenvolvimento e/ou validação das metodologias analíticas para métodos de identificação, teor, uniformidade de conteúdo, dissolução e substâncias relacionadas;
Desenvolver metodologias indicativas de estabilidade e executar os testes de degradação forçada dos insumos farmacêuticos ativos e produtos;
Elaborar monografias de análise dos produtos, insumos e matérias primas;
Executar análises físico-químicas relacionadas aos estudos de estabilidade dos produtos;
Elaborar documentação dos produtos em estabilidade, emitindo laudos, pareceres e relatórios técnicos dos resultados observados;
Elaborar/Revisar procedimentos operacionais padrão dos equipamentos e atividades do setor de acordo com a demanda;
Elaborar o dossiê dos produtos e pesquisas sob responsabilidade de sua área de atuação, compilando todos os documentos relativos à condução das atividades de desenvolvimento analítico, visando a submissão na ANVISA.
Contribuir para investigações analíticas, "troubleshooting", desvios e análises de tendência;
Garantir o cumprimento das Boas Práticas de Laboratório (BPL) e diretrizes de integridade de dados

description:
Descrição da vaga

Diversidade e Inclusão na TIM é MAIS que abraçar. É uma cultura cada vez MAIS essencial para o nosso dia a dia. É criar um impacto MAIS positivo sendo quem você é. Vem ser você e fazer parte de um TIMe que tem a coragem para inovar, a liberdade para tentar e a vontade de fazer a diferença na vida das pessoas. #imagineaspossibilidades


Valorizamos a candidatura de Pessoas com deficiência, Pessoas negras, Pessoas LGBTI+, Pessoas 45+ e Mulheres

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Responsável pelo gerenciamento de equipamentos de infraestrutura Cloud Datacenter e virtualização de funções de rede (NFV).

Requisitos e qualificações

Principais atividades

  • Executar atividades de configuração, gerenciamento e troubleshooting em ambientes de virtualização e containers (Hypervisors, Maquinas virtuais, Switches Virtualizados (SDN), Datastores físicos (LUN) e virtualizados (VSAN, CEPH e FusionStorage), PODs e containers, servidores, storages, etc.);
  • Realizar testes de aceitação e validação funcional de novos elementos e sistemas;
  • Atuar junto às equipes responsáveis para validar e garantir o funcionamento das integrações com ferramentas de monitoração e inventário;
  • Documentar rotinas operacionais e propor melhorias nos procedimentos técnicos;
  • Monitorar indicadores de performance e ajustar configurações para otimização de recursos e prevenção de contenções;
  • Realizar troubleshooting em sistemas operacionais Linux e Windows Server (bare metal e virtualizados);
  • Apoiar tecnicamente projetos de evolução da infraestrutura NFVi, como upgrades, migrações e integrações;
  • Colaborar com equipes técnicas para resolução de problemas e melhoria contínua dos ambientes.

Conhecimento, Experiência, Formação

  • Formação Superior Completa preferencialmente em Engenharia de Telecomunicações, Tecnologia da Informação e Sistemas de Computação;
  • Experiência em Operação e troubleshooting de ambientes virtualizados ou NFVi de médio e grande porte;
  • Experiência em Servidores rack e blade de mercado (Huawei, Dell, HPE, Nokia) e storages (Huawei e HPE);
  • Conhecimento em Hypervisors e virtualizadores como VMWare, Red Hat OpenStack, RedHat CoreOS (OpenShift), Huawei FusionSphere e FusionStage;
  • Conhecimento em Sistemas operacionais Linux (RHEL, CentOS, Debian) e Windows Server;
  • Conhecimento em Ferramentas de monitoração e gerenciamento de datacenters (NMS, Element Managers), tais como OpenManage, NADCM, OneView e E-sight;
  • Diferencial ter Certificações de mercado tais como: VMWare VCP (Data Center/NSX), RedHat CSA (RHCSA), Microsoft AZ-800 e AZ-801, ITIL Intermediate, COBIT, SCRUM, Lean Six Sigma e Yellow Belt;
  • Diferencial ter participado de troubleshooting de networking em sistemas operacionais de mercado (bare metal e ambiente virtual VMWare);
  • Diferencial possuir conhecimento em automação e scripting, tais como: Shell, Ansible, PowerCLI, Perl e Python;
  • Diferencial possuir conhecimento em aplicações de Inteligência Artificial para análise preditiva de falhas e automação de operações;
  • Diferencial possuir conhecimento em Infraestrutura como Código (IaC), com uso de ferramentas como Terraform e Ansible;
  • Diferencial possuir experiência com ferramentas modernas de observabilidade e telemetria, como Prometheus, Grafana e ELK Stack;
  • Diferencial possuir conhecimento em práticas de segurança aplicadas a ambientes virtualizados, incluindo hardening de hypervisors e gestão de acesso;
  • Diferencial possuir conhecimento em ferramentas de dados como Power BI e Power Automate para análise de performance e automação;
  • Diferencial possuir conhecimento básico em tecnologias de contêineres e orquestração, como Docker e Kubernetes;
  • Inglês Intermediário (leitura, conversação e escrita).

Informações adicionais

Na TIM, o seu bem-estar é o nosso bem-estar, por isso o programa Conexão Bem + Estar tem o propósito de fortalecer o cuidado genuíno da TIM com o TIMe e suas famílias, por meio de iniciativas práticas em diversas frentes para todos e todas estarem sempre bem, na vida pessoal e profissional.

  • Atuar no processo de integração de novos colaboradores, garantindo uma experiência acolhedora e eficiente;
  • Apoiar a aplicação e análise de pesquisas de engajamento, contribuir para programas de reconhecimento e colaborar na elaboração de planos de ação com base no feedback dos colaboradores;
  • Participar da criação e divulgação de conteúdos, eventos e campanhas internas que reforcem os valores da Haleon e fortaleçam as ações e processos de RH.

title: Analista de Dados Sr
description:
Somos a IPmedia

Uma startup de tecnologia com diversos produtos no mercado de encontros online, com mais de 9 anos de operação. Somos uma empresa apaixonada por tecnologia que deseja quebrar as barreiras de distância entre as pessoas, através de novas tendências e crescimento.

Em nosso ambiente colaborativo e inovador, enfatizamos a liberdade de trabalhar de qualquer lugar do mundo ou no conforto da sua própria casa, promovendo um livre fluxo de ideias. Valorizamos o desenvolvimento e o crescimento de nossos profissionais, oferecendo cursos de treinamento e oportunidades de aprendizado. Trabalhamos com tecnologias de ponta, tanto no desenvolvimento quanto na infraestrutura.

Requisitos:

Procuramos um Analista Sênior que seja hands-on com SQL e Python que goste de desenvolver pessoas.
Você vai liderar um time de 2 analistas de dados, sendo responsável por definir padrões, revisar entregas, fazer pair programming e garantir a excelência técnica do grupo, sempre com a mão no código.
Queremos alguém que escreva SQL diariamente ao mesmo tempo que ensine o time a pensar em performance, legibilidade e escalabilidade.

O que você vai fazer:

  • Liderar o time de BI, orientando tecnicamente, revisando código e conduzindo sessões de aprendizado prático.
  • Escrever e otimizar queries SQL complexas em MySQL 8 (core) e PostgreSQL (novos serviços).
  • Ser responsável por lógicas críticas de atribuição de tráfego e produto, com impacto direto na receita e nas decisões estratégicas.
  • Guiar decisões de modelagem e estruturação de dados, garantindo coerência entre dashs, processos e camadas analíticas.
  • Estabelecer padrões de boas práticas SQL e modelagem relacional, promovendo consistência e qualidade a longo prazo.
  • Fazer pair programming e code reviews, ensinando na prática e elevando o nível técnico do time.
  • Trabalhar lado a lado com engenharia e produto, assegurando que as decisões de negócio estejam refletidas corretamente nos dados.
  • Apresentar os KPIs semanais e mensais de forma clara e acessível, assegurando que toda a equipe esteja atualizada sobre o desempenho e os resultados.

O que você precisa saber | ter:
Imprescindível:

  • 5+ anos de experiência com SQL em produção, em sistemas com dados críticos ou financeiros.
  • Domínio profundo de índices, execution plans, particionamento e otimização de queries.
  • Experiência sólida com MySQL e PostgreSQL em ambientes produtivos.
  • Capacidade comprovada de mentorar e ensinar você será a referência técnica do time.
  • Vivência com Git workflow colaborativo (branches, pull requests, revisão e versionamento de scripts).
  • Conhecimento consistente de modelagem de dados relacionais e garantia de consistência entre camadas.

Legal se souber | experiência:

  • Experiência prévia em liderança técnica de times de dados.
  • Inglês intermediário ou acima, para leitura de documentação e colaboração com outros times.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de versionamento e deploy de dados (ex: dbt, Liquibase, Flyway).
  • Vivência com monitoramento e auditoria de dados críticos.
  • Experiência em ambientes colaborativos e ágeis, com foco em melhoria contínua.
  • Participação ativa em comunidades técnicas de SQL, PostgreSQL ou MySQL.

title: RODOVIA l COORDENADOR(A) DE COMUNICAÇÃO
description:
Descrição da vaga

Quer mover a sua carreira na Motiva?
A Motiva é o lugar certo para o seu talento, na qual você pode escolher o caminho que deseja seguir juntamente com uma empresa que promove a melhoria da qualidade de vida das pessoas por meio da mobilidade. Nos comprometemos em construir uma cultura cada vez mais diversa e valorizamos a inclusão de todas as pessoas independente de cor, etnia, religião, idade, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual ou deficiência, promovendo um ambiente inclusivo e com equidade de oportunidades.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Atuar na comunicação da unidade de negócios, desenvolvendo e implementando estratégias integradas de comunicação externa, interna, digital, imprensa e eventos, alinhadas às diretrizes da Plataforma Motiva. Garantir o posicionamento institucional da unidade junto aos públicos locais, fortalecendo a imagem da marca e promovendo relacionamento transparente e eficaz com imprensa, sociedade e stakeholders.

Ser responsável pela produção e curadoria de conteúdos específicos e regionalizados, assegurando relevância, consistência e agilidade na comunicação. Monitorar continuamente os canais físicos e digitais, antecipando riscos, gerando insights estratégicos e contribuindo para decisões informadas. Atuar com protagonismo na gestão de crises e no atendimento à imprensa em plantões, fora do horário comercial e aos finais de semana.

Principais Desafios

  • Preservar e fortalecer a reputação da Motiva em sua atuação regional, especialmente em momentos críticos.
  • Gerenciar comunicação em situações adversas, garantindo consistência na imagem institucional.
  • Elaborar pautas estratégicas e conteúdos relevantes que ampliem índices de reputação.
  • Atuar de forma integrada com diversas áreas, acompanhando repercussão nas mídias e métricas.
  • Validar entregas de fornecedores e parceiros, assegurando qualidade e prazos.
  • Promover sinergia entre comunicação interna e externa, garantindo consistência na narrativa.
  • Coordenar e desenvolver equipe local, orientando para metas e cultura de excelência.

Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e coordenar ações de comunicação externa, interna, digital e eventos.
  • Gerir relacionamento com imprensa local, elaborando pautas, releases e acompanhando publicações.
  • Atuar em regime de plantão para atendimento à imprensa fora do horário comercial.
  • Produzir conteúdos estratégicos e regionalizados, alinhados à identidade da marca.
  • Monitorar canais físicos e digitais, antecipando riscos e gerando insights.
  • Inserir conteúdos em plataformas digitais e apoiar produção de materiais audiovisuais.
  • Garantir execução de contratos com fornecedores e elaboração de briefings claros.
  • Capacitar porta-vozes para entrevistas e eventos, alinhados às diretrizes estratégicas.

Requisitos e qualificações

O Que Esperamos De Você
Inglês e espanhol em nível intermediário;

Graduação em Comunicação ou Jornalismo;

Especialização em mídia, digital, conteúdo e branding.

Você Se Destaca, Se Tiver
Conhecimento em marketing, mídia, digital, conteúdo e branding;

Conhecimento em relacionamento com a imprensa, gramática e redação, relacionamento interpessoal.

Informações adicionais

Ao entrar para o nosso time integrado, você fará parte de uma empresa presente em
13 estados
do país e que movimenta milhares de pessoas diariamente ao oferecer mobilidade de forma íntegra e que gera impacto positivo na sociedade. Aqui, você encontrará diversos benefícios para apoiar o seu desenvolvimento e dar mais movimento para a sua carreira.

Confira Os Benefícios Que Oferecemos
Assistência Médica-Hospitalar;

Assistência Odontológica;

Seguro de Vida;

Vale Refeição ou Alimentação;

Vale Transporte ou Estacionamento no local;

Previdência Privada;

Licença Estendida: maternidade 180 dias e paternidade 20 dias;

Auxílio Creche;

Wellhub (Gympass);

Day off aniversário (Folga);

PLR (Participação nos lucros ou resultados);

Política de flexibilidade na jornada de trabalho, e muito mais

Quer melhorar a vida das pessoas através da mobilidade e contribuir para chegarmos ainda mais longe? Então, traga o seu talento para a Motiva.
SOBRE A MOTIVA

A Motiva é feita de pessoas interessadas em contribuir para o nosso propósito: melhorar a vida das pessoas através da mobilidade.
Somos referência em infraestrutura de mobilidade no Brasil, liderando o setor com foco na criação de valor sustentável e melhorando a vida das pessoas através da mobilidade. Atuamos em serviços de infraestrutura para mobilidade, focados nos segmentos de concessão de rodovias, trilhos e aeroportos.

São mais de 16 mil colaboradores responsáveis pela gestão e manutenção de 4.475km de rodovias, por onde circulam cerca de 2 milhões de veículos, diariamente. Nos trilhos, administramos serviços de transporte de passageiros de metrôs, trens e VLT, transportando diariamente, 3 milhões de passageiros. E no segmento de aeroportos, com 20 terminais sob nossa gestão, atendemos mais de 40 milhões de clientes anualmente.

Para que os clientes possam chegar em segurança nos seus destinos, a Motiva investe em práticas que reforçam o compromisso com o meio ambiente, com o social e com a governança, construindo infraestrutura, implementando serviços e oferecendo oportunidades.

title: Mechanic III
description:
POSITION PURPOSE (Overview):

Perform preventive and corrective maintenance services on aircraft, ensuring compliance with Brazilian aeronautical regulations, manufacturer manuals, and technical documentation, with the goal of maintaining full operational reliability and airworthiness of the fleet.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES:


• Perform maintenance, repairs, and both scheduled and unscheduled inspections on aircraft, in accordance with the Daily Maintenance Report (RDM), Work Orders (OS), Maintenance Sheets, and manufacturer manuals, ensuring full adherence to the Aircraft Maintenance Program and regulatory standards.


• Conduct pre-flight, between-flight, and post-flight inspections, ensuring that all items listed in the relevant inspection sheets are verified and that the aircraft is in safe operating condition for all planned missions.


• Execute scheduled inspections and component replacements according to the maintenance planning system (RAMCO), ensuring that all required inspections and component life limits are properly followed.


• Perform troubleshooting and corrective actions on mechanical, hydraulic, and pneumatic systems, following manufacturer procedures and safety standards.


• Record all maintenance activities accurately in the applicable logs and systems, ensuring traceability, compliance, and alignment with the company's quality and safety management system.


• Support the continuous improvement of maintenance processes by suggesting technical and procedural enhancements that increase efficiency, safety, and reliability.


• Maintain the work area organized and compliant with safety and cleanliness standards, preventing risks and ensuring a safe working environment.


• Provide technical guidance and share best practices with lower-level mechanics, supporting the development of less experienced team members.


• Perform other related duties as assigned, within the scope of the position and the company's operational needs.

title: Associate Director of Creative, Acquisition
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across the various e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growthe

What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders' contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About the Role

We're looking for a visionary creative leader with deep experience in developing ad concepts for digital paid media advertising formats on Meta, TikTok, and other channels. You're able to dive deep into the pixels and give tactical feedback on design and video, but understand how to thread the needle between performance frameworks, creative testing, and world-building assets. You're likely a Creative Strategist by trade with a background in Design, Video Editing, or Performance Marketing. You are hyper-focused on paid media performance and developing advertisements that sell products and services.

You'll work on our Performance Creative service—our Al-powered creative strategy engagement for paid media clients that want to work with us on the following:

  • Expertise: Engage us for our expertise in creative strategy, which includes assessing the efficacy of their ad hooks, ad bodies, and general creative direction. You will have a clear perspective on how to improve this over time.

  • Sales: Deliver game changing creative ads that sell their products and services better than anyone else.

  • Diversity: Increase the creative diversity of their ad program through the use of multiple ad formats: statics, motion, video, UGC, AI.

  • Volume: Increase the volume of their performance creative program by delivering upwards of new ads per month with the intention of scaling that as needed.

This role is for individuals who want to be at the forefront of digital advertising, AI in marketing, and join a team that is building the best creative advertising culture in the business. You will work directly on our Creative Team, which works with our clients to enhance their Creative Output. You will also work with both our Social Commerce team to enhance UGC creative and our Paid Media team to plug into their ad scaling strategies. Generally, your work will be the lifeblood of our ad programs.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of creativity, AI, and performance - combining bold visual storytelling with data-informed design decisions. You'll report to the Director of Creative and lead the management of Designers and Editors to execute paid media assets across a variety of formats, including static ads, short-form videos, motion graphics, and UGC content. Your work will directly impact client performance by delivering a high-volume of ad concepts, elevated creative direction, and data-backed testing frameworks.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English.

What you'll do:

  • Creative Strategy: Lead high-tempo creative strategy and direction for full-funnel ad programs, typically Meta and TikTok, but also YouTube, Amazon, and Display Platforms.

  • Short Form Video Expert: Deliver expert advice, concepts, directions, and briefs to sell products and services through short-form video.

  • Data Analysis: Translate client's marketing strategy and performance data into clear, compelling ad concepts (This includes using metrics like thumb-stop rate, hold rate, and clickthrough rate. You're super comfortable adapting creatives to impact these metrics.)

  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Brief Designers and Editors on the creation of assets including static ads, animations, mobile-first videos, and storyboards for short-form content. You're capable of jumping into shape up a design in Figma or whip up an ad yourself without concern, if need be. This isn't the role for strategy-only folks.

  • Executive Presentation: Present creative work to stakeholders and clients with clarity, confidence, and strategic rationale.

  • Performance Iteration: Monitor performance data in collaboration with the marketing team to inform creative iterations and improve results over time.

You should apply if this sounds like you:

  • 3+ years of creative strategy work on performance ad programs, with specific focus working on short form video and statics. If you have not made any short-form video or driven creative strategy on Meta, this role is not for you.

  • A digital portfolio showcasing performance ad work that includes short-form video, motion, and statics. Examples of what you did to impact metrics like hold rate or CTR. Evidence of strong creative diversity that includes both highly designed and low-fidelity creative.

  • You can storyboard, cut, and ship ads. You can jump into Figma to fix hierarchy and pacing, and into Photoshop or Illustrator to polish assets. Strategy-only folks will not be a fit.

  • You speak in hooks, angles, and metrics. You know thumb-stop rate, 3-second hold, hook retention, CTR, and CPA, and you use them to decide what to test next.

  • You already use tools like ChatGPT, Midjourney, Perplexity, Icon, Runway, or similar to increase speed and volume. You have shipped ads with AI-assisted elements, not just experiments.

  • You're an excellent communicator, both in writing and when presenting to clients. You give crisp, actionable feedback to designers and editors and know how to navigate pushback from clients

  • You can turn vague goals into testable concepts, track results, and call the next iteration without hand-holding.

  • Deep in Figma including Auto Layout, Components, and handoff. Strong in Adobe Creative Suite.

Hard disqualifiers

  • No Meta performance creative ad experience.

  • No portfolio link or no performance context.

  • Strategy-only with no hands-on design ability.

  • Not excellent in client presentation and salesmanship.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. title: Sr. Director/Director Data Intelligence
description:
Company Description

We are PrimeVigilance (part of Ergomed Group), a specialised mid-size pharmacovigilance service provider initially established in 2008. We are proud to have achieved global organic growth year after year, with staff based across Europe, North America and Asia all covering services within: Medical Information, Pharmacovigilance, Regulatory Affairs and Quality Assurance.  

PrimeVigilance provides first class support to our small to large pharmaceutical and biotechnology partners maintaining long lasting relationships and becoming one of the global leaders in its fields. We cover all therapy areas including medical devices.  

We love investing in our staff by providing an excellent training and development platform. We value employee experience, well-being and mental health and we acknowledge that a healthy work life balance is a critical factor for employee satisfaction and in turn nurtures an environment from which a high-quality client service can be achieved.  

Come and join us in this exciting journey to make a positive impact in patient's lives.   

Job Description

The Sr. Director/Director, Data Intelligence (ADDI) will support pre-award study feasibility strategy through targeted data gathering and analysis.

ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Supports overall operational strategy globally, with a focus on our key therapeutic areas of Oncology and Rare Disease, so as to maximize Ergomed's revenue and reputation by ensuring that relevant data from available data sources are researched, aggregated, and available to the Directors of Operational Strategy (DOSs) in the timelines required to prepare and deliver high quality, well-research proposals to Ergomed's potential clients.
  • Assists with RFP, RFI, proposal review and response as directed by developing strategically targeted feasibility and related data packages including relevant graphics that support the Win Strategy for new business opportunities.
  • Analyzes trial protocols, study designs, and other project details to determine feasibility within the organization's capabilities and knowledge base and leverages those analyses when presenting feasibility data package.
  • Evaluates potential risks, challenges, and constraints associated with proposed projects, with a focus on any potential impact on feasibility activities and recruitment rate projections.
  • Researches and analyzes the current market trends, competitive landscape, and therapeutic area dynamics relevant to each proposed project.
  • Develops and maintains feasibility summaries including relevant graphics for specific indications as requested by the direct supervisor or the SVP, SSPC to minimize rework (e.g., landscape summaries for certain oncology indications as determined by the Director of Operational StrategyOncology, the Senior Director of Operational and Clinical Intelligence and/or the SVP, SPCC).
  • Documents which feasibility activities and search criteria have been used when transferring preaward feasibility data packages internally in case of absence to minimize rework or at project handover to post-award feasibility team.
  • Supports the development of processes and solutions to maximize pre-award feasibility package development and integration into the larger win strategy.
  • Tracks and provides information on potential data sources, including return on investment, to support executive investment decisions regarding acquisition of or access to future data sources.
  • Develops materials for bid defenses.  Attends bid defense preparation and bid defense meetings as requested.
  • Develops cases studies and reports as requested.
  • Supports SVP, Strategic Solutions and Patient Centricity and/or direct supervisor as needed on projects and activities.

Qualifications

Degree educated in Life    Sciences or equivalent 

  • Clinical research experience in Rare Disease and/or Oncology
  • Global feasibility experience
  • Experience managing  external partners
  • Previous experience in a CRO environment
  • Report writing and presentation skill
  •  Ability to handle multiple tasks to meet deadlines 

Ability to access, aggregate and distill data to create targeted data packages to support strategic goals.

Additional Information

Why PrimeVigilance  

We prioritize diversity, equity, and inclusion by creating an equal opportunities workplace and a human-centric environment where people of all cultural backgrounds, genders and ages can contribute and grow.   

To succeed we must work together with a human first approach. Why? because our people are our greatest strength leading to our continued success on improving the lives of those around us.  

We offer:  

  • Training and career development opportunities internally   
  • Strong emphasis on personal and professional growth  
  • Friendly, supportive working environment  
  • Opportunity to work with colleagues based all over the world, with English as the company language  

Our core values are key to how we operate, and if you feel they resonate with you then PrimeVigilance could be a great company to join   

  • Quality  
  • Integrity & Trust   
  • Drive & Passion   
  • Agility & Responsiveness   
  • Belonging  
  • Collaborative Partnerships   

Come and join us in this exciting journey to make a positive impact in patient's lives. We look forward to welcoming your application.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Software Engineer to work on Linux, cloud infrastructure, pipelines and automation, and open source software.

You will work closely with Amazon, Microsoft, Google and other world-class cloud partners to make Ubuntu the best platform there is in the clouds. Your time will be split between build system development (using Python, Jenkins and shell), implementation of cloud-related features within Ubuntu Server itself, operation of our continuous delivery pipelines, and direct partner engagement. You will strive to automate the delivery of existing and new Ubuntu products applied to all modern workloads from web servers to GPU-aided AI for servers, VM's and containers, and integrate our products with cloud native services.

Come build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, a growing international software company. As a part of our team, you will combine software development skills with software and infrastructure delivery experience.

What the role entails

  • Build automated, highly reliable image delivery, testing and publication pipelines
  • Design, build and integrate new features and enhancements into Ubuntu that will support users of Ubuntu in public clouds
  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Write high quality code to create new features
  • Design and architect complex new systems and integrations with the clouds
  • Debug issues and produce high quality code to fix them
  • Review code produced by other engineers and participate in design discussions
  • Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 weeks for internal and external events
  • Engage with many other teams at Canonical, as well as the open source community and commercial partners

What we are looking for in you

  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • You have practical experience with public clouds
  • You have interest and experience with at least 3 of the following: containers (docker, kubernetes, etc.), devops automation, open source projects, APIs, Linux systems administration, Python packaging, cloud-based applications
  • at least experience in Python software development on Linux

What we offer colleagues


We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical


Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer


We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Mechanical Technician
description:
Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore's True. Blue. Transition. Now, see how a role change can develop you, and us, even more.


About Us:
SBM Offshore is the world's deepwater ocean-infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production in offshore oil and gas. True. Blue. Transition. is our promise. It means continuing to enable decarbonization and support the energy transition, while diversifying our unique capabilities to help more blue economy industries grow and thrive sustainably. Through our strategy of Advancing Our Core and Pioneering More and our values of Care, Integrity, Collaboration, and Ownership, we are sharing our experience for a better blue tomorrow.

Reports To


  • Mechanical Supervisor

    • Background


  • The Technician is responsible for executing maintenance and preservation tasks efficiently and safely to ensure the reliability and longevity of equipment. This role involves performing a variety of maintenance and preservation activities, including but not limited to cleaning, housekeeping, blasting, spraying/painting, isolation and reinstatement, greasing application, and the preservation of topside items like flanges, bolts and valves.
  • The technician is also responsible for ensuring that his supervisor is made aware of all activities according to procedure, especially when safety is an issue.
  • The technician/operator will demonstrate exemplary safety awareness and technical competence in all aspects of maintenance and preservation work on and around the vessel.

    • Authority


  • A Mechanical Technician is authorized to maintain and repair vessel mechanical equipment and systems.

    • Immediate Subordinates


  • Subcontractors, Visitors, Vendor Representatives Instrumentation probationer techs.

    • Accountable For: Responsibilities & Standards


  • 1) Dismantle Repair and Reassemble Mechanical Equipment.
  • 1 Identify potential sources of hazard prior to dismantling.
  • 2 Use correct procedures and correct method of dismantling.
  • 3 Carry out the correct isolation and disconnection procedure.
  • 4 Identified, checked and prepared components.
  • 5 Apply appropriate tests and test equipment to ensure reassembly is correct and effective.
  • 2) Use of Condition Monitoring on Mechanical Equipment.
  • 1 Adjust instruments to meet the operating specification.
  • 2 Make adjustments with minimum disruption to any ongoing activities and minimum waste of resources.
  • 3 Monitor and record what has been carried out in work history or log.
  • 3) Diagnose faults in Mechanical Equipment.
  • 1 Respond promptly to problems in line with approved procedures.
  • 2 Select appropriate tests and diagnostic procedures and apply them methodically.
  • 3 Carry out Visual, Close and Detailed inspections on Mechanical equipment.
  • 4 Use the results of inspections to determine the appropriate actions to take.
  • 5 Record an accurate and full description in the appropriate document history.
  • 4) Monitor and Maintain Pollution Control Measures.
  • 1 Unplanned discharges to the environment are identified, halted where possible, and reported according to policy, procedure and regulation.
  • 2 Relevant PPE is used to deal with unplanned discharges using company procedures.
  • 3 Equipment, waste or other materials for disposal are dealt with according to the correct procedure.
  • 4 Environmental protection and pollution control are enforced effectively with colleagues, subordinates and subcontractors.
  • 5) Contribute to The Health and Safety of the Working Environment
  • 1 Work area within your own responsibility is kept clean and free of hazards.
  • 2 Positive action is taken to stop hazards and unsafe behaviors.
  • 3 Alarms are raised as appropriate and/or acted upon using applied policies and procedures or initiative.
  • 4 All potential and actual incidents are reported to the relevant supervisor.
  • 6) Emergency Response
  • 1 Carry Out Emergency Response role (See Station Bill).
  • 2 Demonstrate competence in Emergency Response drills and exercises.

    • Recruitment Only-Generic Functional Competencies


    Offshore - Demonstrate an Understanding of PandIds Offshore - Routine Servicing of Systems and Equipment Offshore - Rectifying Faults in Systems and Equipment Offshore - Handover Offshore - Emergency Response Offshore - Diagnosis and Fault Finding Offshore - Planning Work Offshore - Dismantling, Repair and Reassemble Equipment Offshore - Safety Management

    Pre-hire Qualifications and Experience


  • FOR GENERAL MECHANICAL TECHNICIAN
  • Proven experience and/or qualified to N/SVQ/HNC/HND in Mechanical Engineering or local equivalent.
  • 3 years' experience desired with offshore experience preferred.
  • Experience and knowledge of hydrocarbon processing systems and utilities.
  • Good experience of Permit to Work, Mechanical Isolation Standards and Risk Assessment.
  • Medically fit according to The Company GEMS Instruction Health Requirements to Work Offshore.
  • FOR PSV CALIBRATION MECHANICAL TECHNICIAN
  • Proven experience and/or qualified to N/SVQ/HNC/HND in Mechanical Engineering or local equivalent.
  • Proven experience and/or qualified In PRV/PSV calibration or local equivalent.
  • 3 years' experience desired with PSV calibration (offshore preferred).
  • Experience and knowledge of hydrocarbon processing systems and utilities.
  • Good experience of Permit to Work, Mechanical Isolation Standards and Risk Assessment.
  • Medically fit according to The Company GEMS Instruction Health Requirements to Work Offshore.
  • FOR CRANE AND HYDRAULIC MECHANICAL TECHNICIAN
  • Proven experience and/or qualified to N/SVQ/HNC/HND in Mechanical Engineering or local equivalent.
  • Minimum of 5 years of extensive experience in Hydraulic Cranes Maintenance. Offshore environment would be preferable.
  • Good knowledge and understanding of Crane and Lifting International Standards
  • Good knowledge of CMMS systems such as AMOS / IFS and ePTW
  • Strong planning & organizational skills
  • Experience and knowledge of hydrocarbon processing systems and utilities.
  • Good experience of Permit to Work, Mechanical Isolation Standards and Risk Assessment.
  • Medically fit according to The Company GEMS Instruction Health Requirements to Work Offshore.

title: Contract Administrator
description:
Overview

WELCOME TO SITA

At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.

You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don't just move the world forward—we're proud to be recognized as a Great Place to Work by our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.

Are you ready to love your job?

The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.

ABOUT THE ROLE & TEAM

Contract Administrator position sits within SITA's Standard Orders Team, reporting to the Team Lead as part of the Americas Business Development group. The role supports SITA customers throughout North, Central, and South America, working closely with Sales and Operations on requests related to existing contracts.

You'll play a vital part in supporting colleagues by ensuring all customer change requests are handled according to requirements, contract terms, and the latest corporate guidelines. Your main responsibility will be overseeing the entire change request lifecycle—from preparing price quotes and change orders to obtaining purchase orders and facilitating billing. While it's not primarily a customer-facing position, there may be occasions where you participate in calls to discuss specific details with customers.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Coordinate with various stakeholders and manage all administrative activities involved in contract change requests, ensuring each step is completed accurately and on schedule, complying with contracts and corporate standards.
  • Simultaneously, manage multiple requests, performing the necessary actions at each stage.
  • Perform various financial and administrative tasks, beginning with understanding of the customer needs from the received request, reviewing contract terms and conditions, and requesting costs input from internal teams and quotes from suppliers.
  • Accurately gather all costs and generate a price quote and/or a change request with tailored assumptions, terms and conditions, following the business approval process.
  • Track progress of each request, provide regular updates to SITA managers and stakeholders, and escalate issues when necessary to ensure timely resolution.
  • Perform daily administrative tasks according to Standard Orders Team workflow, including prompt reporting to stakeholders, end-users, and processing billing submissions.
  • Prepare reports, assist with presentations related to change requests, and distribute documents to appropriate parties.
  • Support the resolution of any issues related to the change request process.
Qualifications

WHO YOU ARE 

  • Technical, Associate, College, or University degree—or equivalent professional experience—in Business Administration, Accounting, Finance, Economics, Computer Science, IT, Telecommunications, or Engineering.
  • Minimum 1-2 years experience in administrative tasks in finance, billing, contract management, compliance, pricing, proposals or project management.
  • Fluency in English, with strong abilities in conversations, meetings, emails, and document editing.
  • Comfort with process-oriented environments, following rules, guidelines, and procedures.
  • Intermediate experience with Microsoft Outlook, Word, and Excel.
  • Ability to collaborate with colleagues from different teams and suppliers and commitment to teamwork, results, and thriving in a dynamic corporate environment.
  • Basic knowledge of Spanish is a plus.
  • Familiarity with PowerPoint, Power BI, and Salesforce is a plus.

WHAT WE OFFER

We're all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We're really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.

Flex Week: Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your team's needs)

Flex Day: Make your workday suit your life and plans.

title: GP Foreman
description:
Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact.  Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore's True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond.
About Us:
SBM Offshore is the world's deepwater ocean-infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production. True. Blue. Transition. is our promise to enable that into the future while at the same time using our expertise to support new and existing markets in the blue economy. It starts with Advancing our Core: continuing to advance the decarbonization of traditional energy production. While Pioneering More: helping to enable the energy transition and using our unique capabilities in ocean infrastructure to support more industries to grow sustainably.  Sharing our experience for a better blue tomorrow.

Reports To

  • Cargo Supervisor

Background

  • The GP Foreman will exhibit a high standard of supervisory and safety behaviour and will ensure that all aspects of shipboard deck maintenance, rigging, slinging, storage, painting and preservation, housekeeping, and general duties are carried out safely and effectively by his team. Delegated tasks will be monitored and controlled formally and effectively.

Authority

  • The GP Foreman is authorized to lead the GP Operators team in activities described above.

Immediate Subordinates

  • GP Operators, Crane Drivers, Visitors, Sub Contractors

Accountable For: Responsibilities & Standards

  • 1) Develop And Maintain Effective Working Relationships
  • 1 Establish and maintain effective working relationships with team, colleagues and visitors to the working environment.
  • 2 Establish and maintain effective communications with team, colleagues and supervisors.
  • 3 Carry out accurate and effective work toolbox talks and handovers.
  • 2) Conduct Slinging and Rigging Operations
  • 1 Perform weight assessments and Risk Assessments prior to lifting awkward loads.
  • 2 Check preparation of loads for lifting (Load is secure and stable).
  • 3 Use various lifting items (plate clamps, barrel lifters chain hoists etc.).
  • 4 Perform bundling and slinging of 'simple' and awkward loads.
  • 5 Maintain slinging equipment (slings, hooks, webbing plate clamps, barrel lifters chain hoists etc.).
  • 3) Perform Effective Signaling/Communications
  • 1 Direct the movement and placing of loads using appropriate hand and radio communication techniques.
  • 2 Rig, sling and position blind load using appropriate hand signals.
  • 3 Rig, sling and position blind load using radio communications.
  • 4) Perform Inspections And Maintain Safe Procedures For Helideck Operations
  • 1 Inspect Helideck for loose materials, protruding objects.
  • 2 Ensure integrity of the Helideck and associated equipment (navaids and landing aids) by conducting checks daily and prior to flight arrivals.
  • 3 Ensure personnel on the Helideck are conducted safely to and from the aircraft.
  • 4 Stow and remove luggage and freight according to safe working practices.
  • 5) Contribute to The Health and Safety of the Working Environment
  • 1 Work area within your own responsibility is kept clean and free of hazards.
  • 2 Positive action is taken to stop hazards and unsafe behaviors.
  • 3 Alarms are raised as appropriate and/or acted upon using applied policies and procedures or initiative.
  • 4 All potential and actual incidents are reported to the relevant supervisor.
  • 5 Record maintenance activities and report defects immediately and effectively.
  • 6) Monitor And Maintain Pollution Control Measures
  • 1 Controlled process or utility discharges from area of responsibility to the environment are within prescribed limits.
  • 2 Unplanned discharges are identified, halted where possible, and reported according to Management System guidelines.
  • 3 Equipment, waste or other materials for disposal are segregated properly and dealt with according to the correct procedure. 7) Emergency Response
  • 1 Carry Out Emergency Response role (See Station Bill).
  • 2 Demonstrate competence in Emergency Response drills and exercises.

Recruitment Only-Generic Functional Competencies


Offshore - Perform Lifeboat Maintenance Offshore - Manage Supply and Crew Boat Operations Offshore - Rigging and lifting Offshore - Emergency Response Offshore - Monitor Weather Condition Offshore - Manage Tanker Arrival Offshore - Perform Fabric Maintenance Offshore - Safety Management Offshore - Fast Rescue Craft duties Offshore - Confined space entries

Pre-hire Qualifications and Experience

  • STCW Reg. AII/4 mandatory minimum requirements.
  • 5 years' experience in ocean-going vessels of which at least 2 should be served as Bosun on oil tankers (VLCC experience preferred).
  • Rigging and Lifting Certified.
  • Banksman Slinger Certified.
  • Experience in crane operations on mobile offshore units desirable.
  • Proficiency in English at a minimum of A2 level according to the CEFR international standard.
  • Medically fit according to The Company GEMS Instruction Health Requirements to Work Offshore

SPECIFIC DETAILS

  • Hiring Manager: Fernanda GONZALEZ 

  • HRBP: Milenna MORAES 

  • We kindly request you to ensure your Lucy profile is up to date and to inform your manager before applying.

title: Especialista em Projetos e Processos
description:
SOBRE A CAPCO

A CAPCO é uma consultoria global de tecnologia e negócios, focada no setor de serviços financeiros e energia, somos apaixonados por ajudar nossos clientes, temos 33 escritórios nas Américas, Europa e Ásia-Pacífico Se você mora no Rio de Janeiro - RJ ou região, dê uma olhada

OBJETIVO

Atuar estrategicamente em subeixos como conformidade, desenvolvimento de competências, negócios, processos, projetos, cadeia de suprimentos e transformação digital, por meio da coordenação técnica, análise crítica, identificação de riscos e oportunidades, e desenvolvimento de soluções e melhorias nos processos organizacionais, oferecendo consultorias especializadas que contribuam para a eficiência, inovação e evolução contínua das atividades.

ATIVIDADES

Atuar nos subeixos de conformidade, desenvolvimento de habilidades e competências, negócios, processos, projetos, cadeia de suprimentos e transformação digital, realizando a coordenação técnica, análises críticas, apoio estratégico, otimizações, estudos técnicos, condução de trabalhos técnicos especializados, desenvolvimento de soluções, melhoria dos processos e atividades, consultorias, identificação de riscos e oportunidades.

ESCOLARIDADE

Pós-graduação: Com carga horária mínima de 360 horas de acordo com os subeixos de atuação.

Graduação: De acordo com o descrito em cada perfil abaixo:

Perfil 1 :Comunicação e Marketing Digital

Escolaridade: Comunicação ou áreas correlatas, tais como Publicidade e Propaganda, Marketing, Administração, Análise de Sistemas ou áreas afins, preferencialmente com pós-graduação ou cursos de especialização em Marketing Digital, Comunicação Integrada ou Gestão de Mídias Digitais.

Experiência: Liderança de equipes multidisciplinares nas áreas de comunicação e marketing digital, atuando de forma estratégica no desenvolvimento, execução e gestão de projetos de comunicação corporativa, branding, campanhas digitais e posicionamento de marcas.

Conhecimentos: Domínio de ferramentas e estratégias de comunicação digital, incluindo gestão de redes sociais, planejamento de conteúdo, campanhas de mídia paga, SEO, analytics, inbound marketing, automação de marketing e relacionamento com influenciadores. Capacidade de análise de métricas e resultados, visando otimização de ações e aumento do engajamento e conversão.

Requisitos desejáveis: Habilidade para liderar equipes, gerir projetos simultâneos, promover inovação, estimular o desenvolvimento contínuo dos colaboradores e garantir alinhamento das ações de comunicação aos objetivos organizacionais; Experiência em gerenciamento de crises de imagem, elaboração de relatórios executivos, interface com áreas internas e externas e atuação orientada por resultados.

Perfil 2: User Experience Designer

Escolaridade: Design, Comunicação, Computação, Análise de Sistemas, Engenharia, Psicologia, ou áreas afins, preferencialmente com especialização ou cursos de extensão em UX/UI Design, Design de Interação, Experiência do Usuário ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência: Em projetos de UX/UI Design, com apresentação de portfólio que evidencie resultados concretos, cases de sucesso e participação em todas as etapas do ciclo de desenvolvimento de produtos digitais focados na experiência do usuário. Domínio do processo completo de UX Design, incluindo pesquisa com usuários (UX research), definição e desenvolvimento de personas, mapeamento de jornadas do usuário, elaboração de wireframes, prototipação em diferentes níveis de fidelidade (baixa, média e alta) e realização de testes de usabilidade. Habilidade para criar interfaces visuais atraentes, funcionais e acessíveis, com domínio em design de layouts, escolha de esquemas de cores, tipografia e aplicação de elementos interativos, sempre alinhados às necessidades dos usuários e aos objetivos do negócio.

Conhecimentos: Experiência avançada com ferramentas de design e prototipação, especialmente Figma ou similares (Adobe XD, Sketch, etc.).

Requisitos desejáveis: Experiência em design e edição de apresentações profissionais de alto impacto para stakeholders e equipes; Habilidades em edição de vídeos para fins de comunicação, treinamento ou divulgação de produtos digitais; Conhecimento em ferramentas da Power Platform (Power Apps, Power BI, Power Automate); Vivência em ambientes que adotam metodologias ágeis, como Scrum e Kanban, com participação ativa em squads de desenvolvimento.

Perfil 3: Cientista de Dados

Escolaridade: Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Estatística, Matemática, Física, ou áreas afins, preferencialmente com especialização em Ciência de Dados, Inteligência Artificial, Machine Learning ou campos correlatos.

Conhecimentos: Domínio de técnicas de Machine Learning, incluindo algoritmos supervisionados e não supervisionados, validação de modelos, análise de desempenho e ajuste de hiperparâmetros; Sólidos conhecimentos em modelagem estatística (análise multivariada, séries temporais), testes de hipóteses e inferência estatística; Habilidade avançada em programação, especialmente em Python, utilizando as principais bibliotecas e frameworks para ciência de dados, machine learning e inteligência artificial; Experiência com tecnologias avançadas de IA, incluindo Large Language Models (LLMs) e Processamento de Linguagem Natural (NLP).

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de Produto
description:
Sobre a BigDataCorp

A BigDataCorp é a maior datatech da América Latina, e democratiza, desde 2013, o acesso aos dados, aumentando possibilidades e certezas em um mundo repleto de incertezas.

Somos pioneiros na captura, estruturação, armazenamento e distribuição de dados no Brasil. Nosso processo é único. Já nascemos adequados à LGPD e às demais regulamentações, garantindo a origem das informações fornecidas, obtidas sempre de forma ética.

Sobre a área e a vaga

A pessoa escolhida irá trabalhar no time de Apps, responsáveis pela manutenção e evolução dos aplicativos disponibilizados pela BigDataCorp no mercado. O foco será no BigID, uma avançada ferramenta de validação de identidade e prevenção à fraude. A atuação será no gerenciamento do desenvolvimento nas subcélulas de Documentoscopia, Biometria, KBA, Device Id e BackgroundCheck. O profissional será responsável por maximizar o valor gerado pelas aplicações, garantindo o alinhamento estratégico do desenvolvimento e a eficiência operacional da equipe em um cenário de crescente automação e complexidade tecnológica.

O que vai fazer no dia a dia

  • Gerir o ciclo de vida das funcionalidades, desde a tradução de requisitos em histórias de usuário até a priorização do backlog com base em um raciocínio estruturado e critérios de impacto, ROI e esforço;
  • Desenvolver e manter o roadmap estratégico das aplicações, identificando e planejando as iniciativas futuras que garantirão a evolução e a competitividade do produto;
  • Liderar a execução tática da equipe no dia a dia, facilitando as cerimônias ágeis, otimizando o fluxo de trabalho no Jira e removendo impedimentos para garantir a previsibilidade das entregas;
  • Atuar como um mentor para a equipe, fomentando uma cultura de autonomia, segurança psicológica e melhoria contínua, e garantindo que o time compreenda o "porquê" estratégico por trás das tarefas que executam;
  • Definir e acompanhar os KPIs e métricas de sucesso para cada entrega, aplicando senso crítico para avaliar o desempenho das funcionalidades no nível operacional e validando hipóteses com testes A/B;
  • Consolidar os resultados e dados de produto para comunicar o valor gerado e o alinhamento com os OKRs da empresa, garantindo o engajamento e a visibilidade junto aos stakeholders e à diretoria;
  • Estabelecer e operar um sistema contínuo de coleta e análise de feedback, dados de uso e entrevistas com clientes para compreender profundamente o desempenho e a usabilidade do produto;
  • Utilizar os insights coletados para realizar análises de mercado, identificar tendências e descobrir novas oportunidades ou dores de clientes não atendidas, informando a estratégia de longo prazo.

Requirements

Habilidades necessárias

  • Experiência em gestão de produtos digitais (ex.: Product Manager, Product Owner etc.), idealmente em ambientes de tecnologia B2B;
  • Elevado senso crítico e raciocínio estruturado para decompor problemas complexos, questionar premissas e validar informações em um ambiente com crescente uso de automação e IA;
  • Experiência em gestão e desenvolvimento de pessoas;
  • Capacidade de aprendizado contínuo, com autonomia para se manter atualizado sobre novas tecnologias, metodologias e tendências de mercado;
  • Inteligência emocional e maturidade para atuar como uma ponte eficaz entre negócio e tecnologia;
  • Conhecimento sobre arquitetura de software (design patterns) e gerenciamento de projetos;
  • Domínio de metodologias ágeis e ferramentas de gestão de projetos (ex.: Jira);
  • Perfil analítico e voltado a dados para fundamentar decisões estratégicas e de priorização;
  • Habilidades de comunicação e negociação para interagir com diferentes níveis hierárquicos, de equipes técnicas a executivos, tanto internamente quanto com clientes externos.

O que faz brilhar os nossos olhos

  • Vivência no setor de dados, analytics ou em plataformas SaaS de alta complexidade;
  • Visão estratégica sobre o impacto e a aplicação de Inteligência Artificial no ciclo de desenvolvimento de software e na evolução de produtos digitais;
  • Compreensão de arquiteturas de software modernas e ambientes de nuvem (AWS) para facilitar o diálogo com equipes de engenharia e avaliar a viabilidade técnica de novas funcionalidades.

Benefits

O que oferecemos
